## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions, error=FALSE}
save_settings <- function(value, filename) {
  path <- file.path(result_dir, "provenance", filename)
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    previous <- jsonlite::read_json(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(previous, value, tolerance = 0))) stop("Existing settings differ: ", path)
  } else {
    jsonlite::write_json(value, path, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", digits = 17)
  }
  path
}
```

## Analysis and output

```{r analysis-and-output, error=FALSE}
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
config_snapshot <- save_settings(neuron_settings, "neuron_settings.json")
root <- normalizePath(result_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
cfgpath <- config_snapshot
cfg <- neuron_settings
.libPaths(unique(c(unlist(cfg$runtime$r_libraries), .libPaths())))
pkgs <- c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "Matrix", "harmony", "uwot", "jsonlite", "future", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "ggrepel", "ragg", "scales")
missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
if (!file.exists(cfg$input_rds) || !file.exists(file.path(cfg$parent_stage1_root, "05_six_class_review", "assignment_complete.json")))
  stop("Completed approved input is missing")
s2_now <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
s2_json <- function(value, path) jsonlite::write_json(value, path, pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", na = "null", dataframe = "rows", digits = 16)
s2_atomic_rds <- function(value, path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) stop("Refusing to overwrite: ", path)
  tmp <- tempfile(".incomplete-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  saveRDS(value, tmp, compress = FALSE)
  if (!file.rename(tmp, path)) stop("Atomic rename failed; temporary object retained: ", tmp)
}

s2_json <- function(value, path) jsonlite::write_json(value, path, pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", na = "null", dataframe = "rows", digits = 16)
s2_atomic_rds <- function(value, path) {

  tmp <- tempfile(".incomplete-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  saveRDS(value, tmp, compress = FALSE)

}

s2_levels <- function(value) {
  ids <- unique(as.character(value)); nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ids))
  ids[order(is.na(nums), nums, ids)]
}

s2_counts <- function(obj, assay) {
  a <- obj[[assay]]
  if (is.null(a)) stop("Missing assay: ", assay)
  layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(a, search = NA)
  cc <- grep("^counts($|\\.)", layers, value = TRUE)
  if (length(cc) != 1L) stop("Expected one counts layer in ", assay)
  x <- SeuratObject::LayerData(a, layer = cc)
  if (!inherits(x, "sparseMatrix") || any(!is.finite(x@x)) || any(x@x < 0) ||
      any(x@x != round(x@x))) stop("Counts must be sparse nonnegative integer UMIs: ", assay)
  x
}

s2_copy_feature_metadata <- function(from, to) {
  if (!identical(rownames(from), rownames(to))) stop("Feature order differs during metadata transfer")
  fm <- from[[]]
  keep <- intersect(c("gene_id", "original_symbol", "seurat_feature", "duplicate_symbol",
    "passes_initial_min_cells", "source_sample_id"), names(fm))
  if (!length(keep)) stop("Original gene identity metadata is missing")
  fm <- fm[, keep, drop = FALSE]; rownames(fm) <- rownames(to)
  SeuratObject::AddMetaData(to, metadata = fm)
}

s2_write_gz_csv <- function(tab, path) {
  con <- gzfile(path, "wt"); on.exit(close(con))
  write.csv(tab, con, row.names = FALSE)
}

x <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3), j = c(1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4), x = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 1, 2),
  dims = c(3, 4), dimnames = list(c("GeneA", "GeneB", "GeneC"), paste0("WD1__test", 1:4)))
assay <- SeuratObject::CreateAssay5Object(counts = x, min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
fm <- data.frame(gene_id = paste0("test", 1:3), original_symbol = rownames(x), seurat_feature = rownames(x), row.names = rownames(x))
assay <- SeuratObject::AddMetaData(assay, metadata = fm)
fresh <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(counts = SeuratObject::CreateAssay5Object(counts = x, min.cells = 0, min.features = 0))
fresh[["RNA"]] <- s2_copy_feature_metadata(assay, fresh[["RNA"]])
stopifnot(identical(s2_counts(fresh, "RNA"), x), identical(as.character(fresh[["RNA"]][[]]$gene_id), fm$gene_id))
umap_default <- get("RunUMAP.default", envir = asNamespace("Seurat"))
ff <- formals(umap_default)
expected <- list(n.neighbors = 30L, min.dist = .3, spread = 1, repulsion.strength = 1, metric = "cosine")
observed <- lapply(names(expected), function(nm) eval(ff[[nm]])); names(observed) <- names(expected)
for (nm in names(expected)) if (!isTRUE(all.equal(observed[[nm]], expected[[nm]], check.attributes = FALSE)))
  stop("Inhibitory Seurat default mismatch: ", nm)
local({
  notebook_lines <- readLines(script_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  starts <- which(startsWith(notebook_lines, "```{r "))
  ends <- which(notebook_lines == "```")
  stopifnot(length(starts) > 0L, length(starts) == length(ends), all(starts < ends),
            all(head(ends, -1L) < tail(starts, -1L)))
  code <- unlist(Map(function(a, b) notebook_lines[seq.int(a + 1L, b - 1L)], starts, ends), use.names = FALSE)
  invisible(parse(text = code, encoding = "UTF-8"))
})
if (!is.null(cfg$runtime$fontconfig_file)) Sys.setenv(FONTCONFIG_FILE = cfg$runtime$fontconfig_file)
font <- system2("fc-match", c("-f", shQuote("%{family}\t%{file}"), "Arial"), stdout = TRUE)
if (!length(font) || !grepl("Arial", font[1L])) stop("Arial font unavailable")
report <- list(status = "pass", checked_UTC = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
  packages = stats::setNames(lapply(pkgs, function(z) as.character(utils::packageVersion(z))), pkgs),
  Seurat_Inh_defaults_verified = observed, sparse_counts_metadata_helper_test = "pass",
  input_file_exists = TRUE, analysis_executed = FALSE, font = font, raw_or_existing_outputs_modified = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(root, "qa"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
jsonlite::write_json(report, file.path(root, "qa", "runtime_preflight.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(report, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE), "\n")
```
